artifacts.title: Consecutive service on different GA committees without sabbatical
artifacts.disposition: No (not eligible); Adopted by the CCB

matches.evidence: The CCB advised that a GA permanent committee member who completed a full term is not eligible for consecutive service on a different committee or agency board without a sabbatical year.

artifacts.title: Effect of presbytery division on advice and consent voting
artifacts.disposition: Yes to (1), No to (2); Adopted by the CCB

matches.evidence: The CCB advised that a newly erected presbytery may give advice and consent on BCO amendments already voted on by its predecessor, but individual presbyters may not vote a second time after transfer.

artifacts.title: SJC member eligibility for concurrent GA agency board service

matches.evidence: The CCB advised that a member of the GA's Standing Judicial Commission is eligible to serve concurrently on the board of a General Assembly agency.
